title: MrDefi
tagline: Cross-chain DeFi platform with Telegram bot trading, 1inch integration & advanced limit orders
description: r DeFi is a revolutionary cross-chain DeFi platform that enables seamless token swaps across multiple blockchains including Ethereum, Polygon, BSC, Aptos, Sui, and Near. The platform features advanced limit order protocols, intelligent trading strategies, and a powerful Telegram bot interface for automated trading. Users can execute lightning-fast swaps (<100ms), manage portfolios, participate in yield farming, and bridge assets between chains - all with bank-grade security and the lowest fees (0.1%). The platform leverages 1inch API for optimal routing and pricing, ensuring users get the best rates across all supported networks.
how_its_made: Built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS for the frontend, featuring a responsive design system with custom animations and gradients. The platform integrates 1inch API for cross-chain swap functionality and implements custom limit order protocols. The Telegram bot is built using modern bot frameworks with real-time trading capabilities. State management utilizes React hooks and context for seamless user experience. The backend leverages Supabase for data persistence, user authentication, and real-time updates. Cross-chain functionality is achieved through various bridge protocols and API integrations for each supported blockchain network.
